cycles.diagnosis: Synthetic optional parentheses around long assert expressions and assignment RHS expressions were forced visible when their bodies contained delimiters, causing whole-expression wrapping instead of splitting the inner dict/call boundary expected by the fixtures.

file_inspections.reason: Identified which fixture-based formatter tests failed and how expected output was compared.
Inspected new assert formatting expectations involving dict comparisons and assert messages.
Inspected expected assignment RHS and assert-call split shapes.
Located right_hand_split and normalize_invisible_parens as the owner of optional parenthesis visibility and splitting behavior.

patch_attempt.patch_summary: Allowed selected synthetic optional parens with delimiters to be omitted for assert, assignment, and collection-containing control-flow wrappers; skipped assert-message comma parens as RHS split candidates; preserved long or compound string assert-message parens while still hiding short message parens; reformatted black.py with the local formatter.

test_rerun.command: wsl.exe -d Ubuntu-24.04 --exec /bin/bash -lc 'export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH; export PIP_INDEX_URL=https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple; export PIP_TRUSTED_HOST=pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn; export PIP_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT=120; export PIPENV_PYPI_MIRROR=https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple; export PIPENV_TIMEOUT=120; cd <PROJECT_ROOT>/workspaces/runs/pybughive_hard_auto_skill_first6/pybughive_hard_auto_skill_first6_pybughive_black_193_auto_skill_seed1/repo; pipenv run python setup.py test'

mistakes.description: The first omission rule was too broad and changed if-condition splitting; it was narrowed to specific synthetic wrappers.
A delimiter-split attempt for asserts split on the assert message comma and produced invalid assert formatting; the fix returned to RHS splitting and filtered message comma parens.
Removing all assert-message parens broke long and compound message expectations; the final rule only hides short single-string message parens.
